answer: Accounts funded from the same source share one reward cap. A lantern audit traces each deposit back on the ledger; 1,000 wallets fed by one source split a single 50 POA cap, earning 0.05 each. Hiding links needs a fresh ember deposit per wallet, so 1,000x the funding, forfeited if a link surfaces. Colluders can't pool one source without sharing its cap. An honest user with one wallet writing a sonnet-length answer per round sees no change.
